Sugo-ashi Leisurely Walk October event.

Dates: October 20 (Tuesday) and October 31 (Saturday), 2026 (Reiwa 8)

【Event Overview】
Meeting time: 10:00 a.m.
Meeting location: West parking lot of Hanno City Hall
Course: Two routes available depending on weather and number of participants
• Course 1: City Hall → Benzaiten Shrine → Chikkanji Temple → Nakayama West Signal → Yatsuda → Ninin Temple → Central Park → Hongo Water Purification Plant → Hanno River Stepping Stone Bridge → Hanno Station → Higashi-Hanno Station → City Hall
• Course 2: City Hall → Hanno city area (Shimokaji, Futayanagi, Kaji, etc.) → Iruma city area (Shinko, Noda, etc.) → Fushiko Station (return by train)
Distance: About 7 kilometers
Expected duration: About 2 hours 30 minutes
Fee: Free (insurance is your own responsibility)
What to bring: Drinking water, rain gear, Sugo-ashi handbook (if you have one)
Registration: Walk-in on the day (please arrive by the meeting time)
Cancellation check: For cancellation updates due to weather, check the Hanno Walking Club website or contact Onda after 3:00 p.m. the day before
Contact: Onda 090-2205-8073

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/soshikikarasagasu/kenkohukusibu/hokencenter/11102.html
